item.title: Qatar condemns Iranian attack on civilian industrial facility in Bahrain
item.description:
Qatar on Sunday strongly condemned the Iranian attack on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain, calling it a flagrant violation of its sovereignty and a breach of international law and the UN Charter. The foreign ministry said continued attacks are a dangerous escalation that threatens regional security and undermines diplomacy, and reaffirmed Qatar's full solidarity with Bahrain and support for all its legitimate measures.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/قطر-تدين-بشدة-الهجوم-الإيراني-الذي-استهدف-منشأة-صناعية-مدنية-بالبحرين · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-iranian-attack-targeting-civilian-industrial-facility-in-bahrain · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265799/latest-news/qatar-condemns-iranian-attack-targeting-civilian-industrial-facility-in-bahrain

item.title: Qatar bourse closes below 10,000 points, down 1.59%
item.description:
The Qatar Stock Exchange index closed Sunday down 159.92 points, or 1.59%, at 9,902.87. Shares of 45 companies fell, 7 rose and 3 were unchanged, with 106.2 million shares worth QAR 254.4 million traded in 14,528 deals. Market capitalisation fell to QAR 603.96 billion from QAR 614 billion in the previous session.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://www.qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/qse-index-closes-lower · Alborsa News https://alborsaanews.com/2026/11/22/2008099 · Elbalad News (MENA) https://www.elbalad.news/7190172

item.title: Inward FDI stock in Qatar rises 5.2% to QAR 180.6 billion
item.description:
The National Planning Council said Sunday the inward foreign direct investment stock rose 5.2% in the second quarter of 2026 from the first, to QAR 180.6 billion, a record high for the third straight quarter. Five activities account for about 95% of the stock, led by mining and quarrying at 41.3% and financial and insurance activities at 36%. Qatar's outward FDI stock fell 2.5% to QAR 220.7 billion.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/المجلس-الوطني-للتخطيط-ارتفاع-رصيد-الاستثمار-الأجنبي-المباشر-إلى-الداخل-52-بالمئة-في-الربع-الثاني-من-2026 · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://www.qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/npc-inward-fdi-stock-rises-52-in-q2-2026 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/المجلس-الوطني-للتخطيط-ارتفاع-رصيد-الاستثمار-الأجنبي-المباشر-إلى-الداخل-52-بالمئة

item.title: Qatar starts second phase of driverless vehicle trials
item.description:
The Ministry of Transport, with Mowasalat (Karwa), on Sunday began the second phase of driverless vehicle test runs in Doha. It involves two level-4 electric vehicles for up to 12 months on approved routes from Old Doha Port and Souq Waqif to West Bay and the end of Diplomatic Street. The first phase covered about one million kilometres against a 500,000-kilometre target.
Sources: Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/المواصلات-تعلن-بدء-المرحلة-الثانية-من-التشغيل-التجريبي-للمركبات-ذاتية-القيادة-بدون-سائق · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/qatar-begins-phase-two-of-electric-robotaxi-test-runs · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265800/latest-news/mot-kicks-off-phase-two-of-electric-robotaxis-test-runs

item.title: Qatar property sales fall 39.1% in a week
item.description:
Qatar property sales totalled QAR 337.1 million in the week of 15 to 21 November, down 39.1% week on week and 53.9% year on year, according to the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (Aqarat). There were 105 transactions; villas accounted for 49.6% of value at QAR 164.7 million, and Doha Municipality led with QAR 107.5 million.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265803/latest-news/qatars-property-sales-fall-39-in-a-week · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/عقارات-انخفاض-قيمة-المبيعات-العقارية-الأسبوع-الماضي-1

item.title: Qatar and South Korea hold second round of political consultations in Doha
item.description:
The foreign ministries of Qatar and South Korea held their second round of political consultations in Doha on Sunday. Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Sultan bin Saad Al Muraikhi led Qatar's side and Deputy Minister for Political Affairs Chung Eui-hae led Korea's; they discussed expanding bilateral cooperation and issues of mutual concern.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265797/latest-news/qatar-korea-republic-hold-second-round-of-political-consultations-in-doha · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/انعقاد-الجولة-الثانية-من-المشاورات-السياسية-بين-دولة-قطر-وجمهورية-كوريا

item.title: QAR 500 settlement for opening vehicle doors without caution
item.description:
The Interior Ministry on Sunday highlighted Article 94 of Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026, which requires drivers and passengers to make sure the road is clear before opening or closing vehicle doors and when boarding, alighting, loading or unloading. The settlement amount for the violation is QAR 500, and these activities should be done on the kerb side wherever possible.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265796/latest-news/qr500-fine-for-unsafe-vehicle-door-opening-boarding-and-alighting-in-qatar · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/قانون-المرور-الجديد-500-ريال-غرامةلمخالفة-ضوابط-الصعود-والنزول-من-المركبات

item.title: Bahrain: two injured in Iranian attacks, Pakistani resident critical
item.description:
Bahrain's Interior Ministry said Sunday that a Bahraini citizen with disabilities and a Pakistani resident were injured in Iranian attacks on Saturday evening, the resident critically. The foreign ministry said Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed the strike on a civilian industrial facility, which caused a fire and material damage. The UAE and Saudi Arabia condemned the attack and declared full solidarity with Manama.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/bahrain/two-injured-in-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain-pakistani-resident-critical-1.500756908 · Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738756/region/bahrains-interior-ministry-reports-two-injured-in-iranian-attacks · Emarat Alyoum https://www.emaratalyoum.com/politics/news/2026-11-22-1.2105332 · Emarat Alyoum https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-22-1.2105328 · Gulf News (live blog) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662

item.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drone launched towards Riyadh
item.description:
Saudi air defences on Sunday intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by Yemen's Houthis towards the Riyadh area, according to Major General Turki Al Maliki, spokesperson for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, as reported by the Saudi Press Agency. No further details were given.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/التحالف-يعلن-اعتراض-وتدمير-طائرة-مسيرة-أطلقتها-جماعة-الحوثي-باتجاه-الرياض · Emarat Alyoum (SPA) https://www.emaratalyoum.com/politics/news/2026-11-22-1.2105334 · Gulf News (live blog) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662

item.title: Saudi index drops 1.95% below 10,000 points
item.description:
The Saudi main index closed Sunday down 198.46 points at 9,960.44, with SAR 2.4 billion traded across 149 million shares, the Saudi Press Agency reported. Shares of 238 companies fell and 29 rose, while the parallel Nomu index dropped 85.85 points to 21,630.53.
Sources: Ajel (SPA) https://ajel.sa/economy/sqjg0mgpf · Elbalad News (MENA) https://www.elbalad.news/7190178

item.title: Nakheel sells 977 Palm Springs homes for AED 5.5 billion
item.description:
Nakheel, part of Dubai Holding Real Estate, said Sunday it had sold all 977 homes released in the first phase of its Palm Springs project near Palm Jebel Ali, for AED 5.5 billion. The phase comprises three- and four-bedroom townhouses and four- and five-bedroom villas, with an average value of about AED 5.63 million per home.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/property/dubais-palm-springs-sells-out-977-homes-in-dh55-billion-launch-1.500756987 · Emarat Alyoum https://www.emaratalyoum.com/business/local/2026-11-22-1.2105340

item.title: Dubai unveils design of Metro Blue Line trains
item.description:
Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, on Sunday reviewed the new design of the Dubai Metro Blue Line carriages during a visit to the project site at Dubai Festival City. The new trains carry up to 1,246 passengers per journey and feature a Gold Class, wireless phone charging and smart lighting.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/dubai/dubai-metro-blue-line-new-look-trains-revealed-gold-class-wireless-charging-and-more-1.500756831 · Emarat Alyoum https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-22-1.2105322

item.title: Dollar ends Sunday at EGP 54.47 at National Bank of Egypt
item.description:
The dollar ended Sunday higher at all Egyptian banks, at EGP 54.37 buying and 54.47 selling at the National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr, and EGP 54.50 selling at the central bank. The rise is about 62 piastres since Thursday's close, which bankers attributed to partial exits by foreign investors from local treasury bills.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628370 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190233 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/22/3082511

item.title: Egyptian bourse loses EGP 142 billion as EGX30 drops 2.85%
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange ended Sunday broadly lower, with the main EGX30 down 2.85% at 49,989.79 and the small and mid-cap EGX70 down 5.55% at 16,534.42. Market capitalisation lost about EGP 142 billion to close at EGP 3.921 trillion, on turnover of EGP 6.6 billion, while foreign investors were net buyers.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628279 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=22112026&id=ebde0c31-c584-4bcc-898f-f03244fe1d2e

item.title: 21-carat gold rises to about EGP 5,520 on local demand
item.description:
The price of 21-carat gold in Egypt rose about EGP 60 on Sunday from last week's close to around EGP 5,520, with 24-carat at about EGP 6,301, according to Youm7. Traders attributed the rise to consumer buying after the recent slide, even with global trading closed for the weekend and the ounce ending near USD 3,538.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628249 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190176 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/22/3082724

item.title: Egypt condemns attack on civilian industrial facility in Bahrain
item.description:
Egypt's foreign ministry on Sunday condemned the attacks on Bahrain, most recently on a civilian industrial facility that caused a fire and material damage, calling them a violation of the kingdom's sovereignty, international law and the UN Charter. Egypt reaffirmed full solidarity with Manama and warned that continued attacks raise tensions and threaten regional stability.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/22/3082649 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=22112026&id=4b3caf2a-d75a-4c29-96c4-c7e96a997272

item.title: World's largest EV battery maker to start production in Egypt in mid-2027
item.description:
Egyptian Industry Minister Khaled Hashem said Sunday the country has attracted the world's largest electric vehicle battery maker, which aims to start production in Egypt by mid-2027. Speaking at the Egypt Automotive summit, he said the government will launch a scheme to replace old cars with electric ones and add new incentives under the national automotive development programme before year-end.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628365 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2533864

item.title: Madbouly reviews plans to deepen mobile phone manufacturing and lower prices
item.description:
Egyptian Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly on Sunday chaired a meeting on deepening mobile phone manufacturing and making handsets affordable, attended by the communications and industry ministers and the heads of the consumer protection and competition authorities. Madbouly said he was following reports of excessive phone price rises and that the meeting would consider possible measures.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628276 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5775800

item.title: Egypt health ministry: flu test positivity at 11%, below global rate
item.description:
Egypt's health ministry said Sunday that 11% of samples tested positive for influenza in the first half of November, against 16% globally and 20% a year earlier, with no new virus detected. Positive samples were split between A/H3 at 41%, A/H1N1 at 33% and influenza B at 26%.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/22/3082728 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628404 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190216

item.title: COP31 ends without a deal after EU rejects final draft
item.description:
UN climate talks at COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, collapsed on Sunday after the European Union, Panama and others rejected the final draft for failing to address fossil fuels. Conference president Murat Kurum told the closing plenary there was no consensus and the decisions were not adopted. The summit ran two days over schedule, the longest on record, and is the first to end without a deal since Copenhagen in 2009.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/fossil-fuel-impasse-pushes-cop31-climate-talks-into-second-day-of-overtime · RTÉ (Reuters) https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1122/1600166-cop31-turkey/ · Daily Sabah https://www.dailysabah.com/turkiye/cop31-ends-without-consensus-as-eu-panama-reject-final-draft/news

item.title: Iran gathers 14 oil tankers near Kharg Island to test US blockade
item.description:
Satellite images and ship-tracking data show more than 14 oil tankers gathered near Iran's Kharg Island, amid reports that Tehran is preparing to send them through the US naval blockade. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said the blockade "must be broken", while the US military said Saturday marked day 130 of the blockade. Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz is 65% below pre-war levels.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/iran-readies-14-tankers-to-break-us-blockade-what-happens-if-they-try-1.500756460 · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/tracking-site-says-iranian-tanker-reportedly-sailing-through-strait-of-hormuz-does-not-exi

item.title: Fire burns for second day on Russian cargo ship off Finland
item.description:
A fire kept burning through Saturday night aboard the Russian cargo ship Sparta II, struck by drones in the Baltic Sea, Finland's coastguard said. The Finnish military said Ukraine likely carried out the strike and that the Kaliningrad-bound vessel drifted into Finnish waters; its 16 crew were evacuated to a nearby Russian ship.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/russian-cargo-ship-still-on-fire-off-finland-after-drone-attack · The Star (Reuters) https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2026/11/22/russian-cargo-ship-still-on-fire-off-finland-after-attack

item.title: Gaza war death toll rises to 74,742 as meningitis warning issued
item.description:
The death toll from Israel's war on Gaza since 7 October 2023 has risen to 74,742, with 176,227 wounded, including 1,675 killed since the 11 October ceasefire, according to medical sources cited by WAFA. Gaza's health ministry warned on Sunday of a record rise in meningitis cases and of surgery halting after hospital supplies ran out.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/ارتفاع-حصيلة-الشهداء-في-قطاع-غزة-إلى-74742-شهيدا-منذ-بدء-العدوان · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738757/region/gaza-health-ministry-warns-of-meningitis-outbreak-as-israeli-occupation-ramps-up-blockade

item.title: BepiColombo probe enters Mercury orbit after eight-year journey
item.description:
The European Space Agency announced that BepiColombo, its joint mission with Japan's JAXA, has entered orbit around Mercury after a journey of nearly eight years. The spacecraft fired four thrusters to slow enough for Mercury's gravity to capture it, entering an elliptical polar orbit of about 590 by 11,640 kilometres. The European and Japanese orbiters are due to separate on 9 and 10 December, with science operations starting in April 2027.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738753/international/esa-announces-successful-insertion-of-bepicolombo-mission-into-mercury-orbit · AeroTime https://www.aerotime.aero/articles/bepicolombo-reaches-mercury-orbit-after-nearly-eight-years-in-space · European Space Agency https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/BepiColombo/Latest_updates_BepiColombo_s_arrival_at_Mercury
